caseName: St. Louis & Hannibal Railroad v. Jackman
caseNameFull: St. Louis and Hannibal Railroad Company v. Mary Jackman
attorneys: Messrs. Daniel Bqrtlett, Thomas L. Philips and Matthew E. O’Brien for defendant in error in support of the motion., Messrs. J. D. Hostetler, George A. Mahan, Dulaneys' M.ahan, J. H. Haley and Richard F. Ralph for plaintiff in error in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction, upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
